name: ai-usage-dashboard
description: Unofficial local dashboard for aggregate AI coding-agent token usage.

interface.shortDescription: Unofficial local aggregate token usage analytics for AI coding agents
interface.longDescription: Unofficial independent project, not made by, affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or supported by OpenAI. Reads supported local coding-agent logs, aggregates exact token usage counters, and generates summaries, CSV exports, and a hoverable dashboard with optional localhost-only raw context loading.
